title: Importing Min, Max and a bin quantity for an untracked part saves them
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPORT-U1, described {Description-A}, for example ZZAUTOTEST PL IMPORT UNTRACKED) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with Min 2 and Max 6 saved while it was tracked and 4 in {Bin-A}.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPORT-U1.csv) holds one row for {Part-A} giving {Bin-A} the quantity 9, Min 3 and Max 8.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Upload {File-A}.
  3. Run the import.
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory and search the part number of {Part-A}.
  5. Read the row's Total Qty, Bin Location / Quantity, Min and Max.
  6. Click the clock icon (tooltip "Part History") on the row.
  7. Read the newest entries.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The import finishes without an error for the {Part-A} row: the row's number matches a part already stocked here, so the import updates {Part-A} and does not refuse it as a duplicate.
  • Step 5: The row still reads "Not Tracked"; Bin Location / Quantity reads "{Bin-A} | 9", Min 3 and Max 8: the imported values were saved just as on a tracked part.
  • Step 7: Part History has the entry "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 3 | Max: 6 → 8 | Source: Import".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-E1 and S7-N7 (an import row matching a stocked part updates it), with the entry text from S10-R22a, read 14 Oct 2026. Tech plan 7 Oct 2026, Phase 6 (the import applies Min, Max and bins to an untracked part). Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3b). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E1: “The parts CSV import can change Min, Max and bin quantities on an untracked part. The values are saved the same way as on a tracked part, and a Min or Max change is written to Part History (S10-R22a).”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | Min: {old} → {new} | Max: {old} → {new} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History, where the source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”
  • Tech plan Phase 6 (ImportInventoryCommandHandler): “Min/Max and bin quantities apply to an untracked part exactly as to a tracked one”
